# scripts/Combat/Arrow.gd

[Source:1](../../../../../scripts/Combat/Arrow.gd#L1)

Declarations come from source. Unannotated types are explicit; see the [system guides](../../../../systems/README.md) for runtime schemas, nullability, ownership, units and side effects.

Ray-swept arrow with gravity, damage, sticking, and inventory retrieval.
Flight has no body collision; each physics tick tests the travelled segment.
A stuck world arrow uses physics layer 3 (value 4) for frob targeting.

Base: `StaticBody3D`. Registered class: `none`.
